normalize_image: normalize an RGB image from 0-255 range to 0-1 range using the normalize_image function
channels_first: convert an image from channels last HWC format to channels first CHW format
scale_intrinsics: scale a camera intrinsics matrix for resized frames using the scale_intrinsics function
pointquaternion_to_homogeneous: convert 3D point and quaternion poses to 4x4 homogeneous transformation matrices
poses_to_transforms: convert a sequence of camera poses to frame-to-frame transformations relative to the first frame
